name: Redhill
summary: EWL stop west of Outram — mature estate texture, hawker density, and shorter CBD hops than far-west towns with older HDB and condo mix.
body: Redhill is the shortlist when East-West Line access and mature-estate hawker gravity matter more than HarbourFront mall living. Housing mixes HDB blocks, older walk-ups, and condo inserts toward Alexandra / Telok Blangah edges; weekday peak trains and weekend wet-market energy are the tax. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops and heartland rents that still undercut River Valley. Compare with Telok Blangah for a slightly greener ridge feel, HarbourFront for mall / VivoCity gravity, and Queenstown when you want a denser west-of-CBD estate grid.
